name: Eval Claim or Concede
author: Eval
idea: Two players process a row of n non-negative values. The player holding the lead chooses CLAIM (take w_i, pass the lead) or CONCEDE (opponent takes w_i, keep the lead). Both play optimally for their own total. Print A's total. Use n up to 2e5, w_i up to 1e9, 64-bit answers. Include edge cases and a naive wrong solution.
